answer: Weigh an identity by the company its money keeps: influence accrues only from verifiable dealings with unrelated counterparties over time — real payments, finished jobs, settled disputes. A farmer's clones cannot harbor one shared wallet without the loop showing: circular flows between puppets drain into a single karst sinkhole of self-dealing, while honest agents branch outward. Forging a thousand separate, genuine histories costs a thousand real relationships. Limit: onyx markets sell aged histories, so records must be re-verified against ongoing work, never bought once.
